newsitem.title: USA: US senator to urge FTC to bar Shell-Texaco merger.
newsitem.headline: US senator to urge FTC to bar Shell-Texaco merger.

text.p: U.S. Senator Barbara Boxer plans to ask the Federal Trade Commission to reject the proposed merger of Shell Oil Co and Texaco Inc's western U.S. refining and marketing operations, a spokesman for Boxer said Tuesday.
"She is urging them to oppose the pending merger," the spokesman said, describing a letter Boxer was drafting to send to the FTC.
The California Democrat, backed by consumer groups, plans to release the letter at a press conference Thursday.

The FTC is in the midst of reviewing the proposal, which five consumer groups led by Citizen Action last month urged the agency to reject saying it would stifle competition on the West Coast, which already has a limited number of refiners and marketers.
The two giants say they have to merge in order to stay competitive in a business that has tight margins and high capital costs.
